title: Children of Dune
author: Frank Herbert
summary: The third Dune novel, set years after the first two. A powerful family's young heirs grow up under the shadow of a vast legacy, while old factions and an empire under pressure scheme to take control of their future.
readIf: you've read the first Dune books and want more of its dense politics, religion and philosophy.
skipIf: you haven't read Dune and its sequel, since this assumes both and has little hand-holding.

pairings.reason: Another far-future saga rich in religion, ideas and big-picture storytelling, with a more varied structure.
A quieter, more humane science fiction classic about culture, politics and perception.
Another classic of the genre focused on empires, long-term planning and the movement of history.
